selected_records.title: The AI policy window is open. We need to act.

article.body:
OpenAI’s AI-policy appeal establishes no policy change

OpenAI’s listed item, “The AI policy window is open. We need to act,” calls for action on AI policy. The available record does not establish a specific proposal, approved rule or government action, nor identify an organisation required to change its practice. It also provides no evidence of a resulting capability or implementation. The item is an appeal, not evidence that policy has changed.
